quests.title: Mutual Exchange

dialogue.t: Yoyo mani mi? Mi muhe Upa Celi nini. Mi muhe mi nunu si, mi muhe mi nye.
It says it doesn't want to see the sun. It wants to fall asleep and never wake up again... Goodness knows what could be causing it so much anguish.
Biat. Mi muhe <color=#00E1FFFF>celi lata</color>. Mi nunu nye.
Hmm, why don't we try giving it something it wants, to try and make it feel better?
Wei? Du odomu tomo zido mi si, du zido <color=#00E1FFFF>unta nunu</color>!
<color=#00E1FFFF>Unta nunu</color>... It's trying to tell us the time, right?

quests.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship…?
